t: The Framework Is The Template: Python as a UI Language
s: This article explores a Python-centric, local-first web development philosophy using FastHTML and HTMX. It advocates for a minimalist stack that transforms Jupyter Notebooks into structured workflows by sending HTML fragments, challenging conventional JavaScript-heavy approaches and emphasizing Python's role as a UI language.
sub: Python as a UI language with FastHTML and HTMX
Jupyter Notebooks as a philosophical and technical foundation
Minimalist web development vs. heavy JavaScript frameworks
The 'dent' of unlearning old paradigms for simpler approaches
